import.title: Import LangGraph repo
import.desc: Clones the repo, installs dependencies into its own venv and reads graphs from langgraph.json (or scans compiled StateGraphs).
import.warning: The repo's code will be executed (in a subprocess + its own venv, not a full sandbox). Only import repos you trust.
import.requiredEnvHint: set them in the server env to run.

human.title: Waiting for your response
human.placeholder: Type a response, or approve / reject
human.pendingDesc: Runs paused at a Human node

api.title: Trigger via API
api.desc: Start this workflow from other systems with a per-workflow token. Runs appear in history with source API.
api.copyOnce: Copy the token now; it is shown only once.
api.name: Token name
api.modes: mode "sync" waits for the result; "async" (default) returns 202 with run_id — poll GET …/runs/{run_id} or pass callback_url to receive the result.
api.signingHelp: Callbacks carry X-Studio-Signature: t=<timestamp>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<timestamp>.<body>")>. Verify it and reject old timestamps (see README).
api.rotated: New signing secret. The previous one keeps signing callbacks until {{when}}, so receivers can switch over.

versions.title: Version history
versions.desc: Every save that changes the workflow creates a version. Compare any two, or restore an older one as a new version.
versions.restored: Restored v{{n}} as a new version.
versions.unchanged: v{{n}} is identical to the current version, so nothing was restored.
versions.unsavedWarning: You have unsaved changes in the editor. Restoring replaces them.

notifyPrefs.title: Notification settings
notifyPrefs.description: Choose how you hear about runs that wait for you or expire.
notifyPrefs.in_appHelp: Show notifications in the bell, live as they happen.
notifyPrefs.emailHelp: Send an e-mail to your account address.
notifyPrefs.emailNotConfigured: E-mail is not set up on this server (SMTP_HOST), so no e-mails are sent yet.

approvals.title: Approval channels
approvals.description: Approve or reject waiting runs from Slack or Telegram. Tokens are stored encrypted.
approvals.keepSecret: Saved, enter a new value to replace

help.slack: Create a Slack app with a bot token (chat:write) and turn on Interactivity with the callback URL below.
help.telegram: Create a bot with @BotFather, save its token, then register the webhook (needs a public https STUDIO_PUBLIC_URL).

approvals.publicUrlMissing: STUDIO_PUBLIC_URL is not set: the platform must reach this server at a public https address.
approvals.identitiesHelp: Link your chat accounts so a button you press in Slack or Telegram counts as you. Only the run owner and the approvers listed on the Human node can approve.

identityHow.slack: Slack: your profile → ⋮ → Copy member ID.
identityHow.telegram: Telegram: message @userinfobot to see your numeric ID.

node.title: Approval channel
node.connectFirst: This channel is not connected yet. Open Approval channels in the user menu.
